R1_01_approval_intent_singleton.mechanism: deterministic intent_id, idempotency_key, and client_order_id derived via sha256 from immutable case_hash:proposal_hash:approval_event_id; approval_event_id stored as UNIQUE natural authority in live_trade_intents; replay under identical approval returns existing authority; divergent payload under same approval fails closed with ExecutionBlocked

R1_02_credential_authority.mechanism: structural CredentialAuthority metadata bound on BinanceSignedClient (.authority) carrying environment, credential_namespace, and rest_base_url; ExecutionCapabilityPolicyV1 validates actual client authority before mutation; TESTNET factory reads only BINANCE_TESTNET_* variables without consuming LIVE env vars; AccountWatch validates signed_client.authority in TESTNET mode

R1_03_preexec_revalidation.mechanism: PreExecutionValidator verifies active proposal on case, approval record actor and recomputed content_hash, distinguishes compile snapshot vs fresh reconciled current snapshot, recalculates RiskPolicy authority & risk limits (daily loss, drawdown, symbol/portfolio exposure, available margin, position counts, open orders), checks Tactical validity provider (fails closed with TACTICAL_VALIDITY_UNAVAILABLE if missing in TESTNET), and prevents local duplicate client_order_id

R1_04_delayed_fill_protection.mechanism: reconcile_intent and submit_intent query exchange open protective orders; if filled_qty > 0 and no protection exists, places protective stop for filled_qty; if existing protection < filled_qty, cancels smaller order and places resized order for full filled_qty; exchange query uncertainty trips KillSwitch and fails closed; protection quantity never exceeds position quantity

R1_05_supervisor_orchestration.mechanism: real execution coordinator (LiveExecutionService.execute_approved_intent and reconcile_intent) orchestrates post-fill PositionObservationV1 directly into PositionSupervisor.process; converts material PositionEvent to PositionCase and delivers to AnalysisService; durable live_position_case_dispatches prevents duplicate analysis across restarts; source-bound market/Tactical inputs are explicitly nullable without neutral masquerade

R1_06_short_position_open.mechanism: PositionSupervisor.evaluate triggers POSITION_OPENED on previous_quantity == 0.0 and quantity != 0.0; supports both long (quantity > 0) and short (quantity < 0) positions with durable open-state tracking and deduplication

secret_isolation: no API keys or HMAC secrets in snapshots, intents, events, or logs; errors sanitized
remaining_blockers: None. All R1-01 through R1-06 safety blockers closed. Real-money LIVE execution remains permanently forbidden.
